description: Get one product's result, when the question is whether an AI agent can use it: send its slug from search_tools, or its name or domain, and get its test-drive result (agent level 0-5, where our agent stopped and why, what it can and can't do, how it gets in and pays). Use get_agent_surfaces instead when you only need its API, MCP, CLI and SDK. Read-only, no key needed; the headline (2.5 to 5 KB) unless brief is false (13 to 35 KB).

brief.description: true (the default here): the headline, 2.5 to 5 KB; false: the full record, 13 to 35 KB, with every checkpoint, way in and claim

slug.description: The product's directory slug from search_tools (e.g. 'attio'), or its name or domain

name: get_tool
title: Get one tool's drive result
